summary: Independent bounded skeptical source review found no substantive defect in the seven frozen production modules. The genuine induced-graph alternative and literal incidence counting establish the stated ordered bad-pair and selected-star budgets; actual covering branch fibers account for all selected/residual cases and establish the conservative full ordered loss bound 4*sum_collisions+ordered_bad_score. The excluded exact host-edge identity wrapper, density-increment assembly, and main upper spanner theorems are not certified.

scope.mode: Read all seven production sources and relevant unchanged definitions/counting dependencies; independently verify frozen source hashes and root import coverage; inspect recorded gates and their implementation; write this report only.

gate_evidence.verification_method: Inspected all five recorded cleaning-budget logs, gate-cleaning-budget.sh, run-lean.sh, run-checker.sh, and the paper-local AxiomAudit.lean; no compiler or checker rerun. Independently checked all source hashes and 107-module root import coverage.
gate_evidence.gate_implementation: set -euo pipefail; all seven new module builds and the aggregate root build use warningAsError=true. The common Lean runner also sets autoImplicit=false. Aggregate runs AxiomAudit.lean and mk_all --check --lib MinorFreeSpanners. Replay runs the Lean 4.34.0 official leanchecker executable separately on each new module. Each phase pass marker follows successful commands.
gate_evidence.audit_implementation: Audits every declaration whose defining imported module has the MinorFreeSpanners prefix, including private/generated declarations, collects transitive axioms, rejects any outside propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound, and rejects an empty audit.
gate_evidence.qualification: These are inspected recorded local build/replay results, not a new independent compiler run or exact-commit CI attestation. The supplied cleaning-budget build logs directly name the seven new module builds plus a 107-module aggregate root; they do not themselves record a fresh separate recompilation of every prior library source.

findings: The theorem retains the exact real induced-graph disjunction: H.card <= 2*(ell+1)*D and r^2 <= 4*card(E(G.induce H)). Its first branch is decided independently of Unmated, which is not even a premise here.

The second branch internally invokes the existing minimum-family chain; MinimumBadStarFamily obtains an attainable minimum of the genuine ordered bad-pair score via Nat.find. Fullness, original-host mate-free branches, and the exact covered-leaf union are preserved. The output need not expose minimality as an additional claim.

The explicit q>=0 and 4*ell*q<=r imply r>=0. A local cardinality at least r meets the quadratic-witness threshold, and monotonicity of squaring on nonnegative values contradicts absence of the dense witness. This proves a strict local incidence bound for every owned leaf of one selected family.

All selected centers and covered leaves have the original degree bound D. The preserved union transfers leaf smallness to the new family; the same actual witness has size <=(ell+1)*(degree u+degree b)<=2*(ell+1)*D.
badStarPairCount is the cardinality of actual ordered distinct-center bad pairs. Its center-sum identity counts both orientations consistently.
Every bad center is included in the union of genuine matedStarCenters and unmatedBadCenters by an explicit membership split; no incidence oracle replaces those sets.

The unchanged unmatedBadCenters_card is an equality: actual unique crossing leaves exhaust all unmated bad neighbors and make different leaf classes disjoint. Summing the supplied per-leaf bound across exactly ell leaves and then across C proves |C|*(a+ell*r). The helper clearly exposes its local bounds as assumptions.
The graph join obtains the same internally chosen family from the genuine dense alternative and derives its local incidence bounds, rather than assuming them.

Preserved covered vertices and D<=K*d give smallness for every center-plus-leaf vertex. The unchanged matedStarCenters_bound applies literal Unmated and branch disjointness to give a=(ell+1)*eps1*d, using q=eps2*d.

The literal Unmated definition bounds the actual filtered universe of vertices whose common-neighbor cardinality reaches eps2*d; it supplies mate counts only and does not eliminate the separate dense alternative.

Restricting center-plus-leaf mate-freeness to leaves permits the genuine collision budget. The selected-star surplus bound retains the factor 2*(ell*(ell-1):Nat)*(eps2*d), added to the ordered bad score. No sign premise is silently added by the algebra.
branchBetweenEdges is the image in Sym2 V of actual adjacent ordered host pairs drawn from the two complete covering branches. It is a real unordered host-edge set, not an abstract count.

For distinct quotient labels, fullStarLabel_eq_iff identifies each fiber with these actual branches. Both representatives of the unordered edge are handled explicitly using symmetry. Distinctness is essential and remains an explicit theorem premise.

The unchanged covering type is C plus starResidual, where starResidual is the complement of the selected center-plus-leaf union and every residual branch is a singleton. No original host vertex is discarded.
A residual/residual product consists of one host pair, so the image-filter fiber has cardinality at most one. Equal residual labels are handled separately downstream.
The selected/residual fiber is exactly the image of adjacent vertices in insert center leaves. The map x -> s(x,z) is injective, so unordered representation creates no duplicate count.

With centers in B and leaves in A, a residual vertex adjacent to the center lies in A. If also adjacent to a leaf, bipartiteness places it in B, contradicting disjointness. Thus this case has exactly one edge and zero excess.

If the center is not adjacent, the fiber is precisely the actual crossing-leaf set. With p its cardinality, Nat-truncated p-1 is at most p*(p-1), including p=0. The right side is the actual directed starCollision.

Sym2.mk_surjective provides an ordered representative of every actual unordered quotient edge. Inclusion into the image of all ordered pairs and nonnegative natural finite sums justify the conservative enlargement.
The image-sum inequality safely overcounts reverse representatives and any extra diagonals; it does not assume an orientation or incorrectly halve an ordered budget.
The instantiated cost is the actual crossing-edge fiber cardinality minus one in Nat. Diagonal fibers are empty because quotientCrossEdges explicitly excludes diagonal mapped edges.
fullStarFiberLoss is defined from actual quotientCrossEdges and actual fullStarLabel fibers. Symmetry is exact, and diagonal loss is zero.
The selected/selected sum is exactly orderedStarSurplus, using the unchanged actual selected fiber cardinality theorem for distinct centers and explicitly removing the diagonal.

The selected/residual sum is paid by the actual collision sum after enlarging the residual subset to all host vertices. Fiber symmetry and sum commutation pay the residual/selected orientation by the same bound.
Residual/residual loss is zero: equal labels have empty crossing fibers; distinct residual branches have at most one edge.

Splitting the sum over the covering sum type includes all four cases. Selected/selected contributes at most 2*S+badStarPairCount and each mixed orientation contributes at most S, so the result is exactly the stated conservative 4*S+badStarPairCount. No category or original vertex is omitted.

explicit_hypotheses_and_scope_limits: The dense/bad-score existence results assume a finite bipartite host, Disjoint A C, a supplied valid exactly-full packing, original-host mate-free center-plus-leaf branches, q>=0, 4*ell*q<=r, and all-branch degree-smallness. The Unmated join additionally assumes D<=K*d and literal Unmated. These inputs are not constructed by this packet.

The full fiber-loss results separately require C subset B, besides the packing and original-host bipartition. The dense-alternative theorem does not expose this same premise. A downstream combined use must supply it; ell=0 alone does not place centers in B.
The helper incidence theorem has explicit local numerical hypotheses; the graph existence theorem derives these from the internally selected family only in the nondense branch.
All subtraction in fiber cardinalities and ell*(ell-1) is natural truncated subtraction before the indicated real casts. Empty fibers and ell=0 are covered without a positivity claim.
At r=0, the empty induced vertex set already satisfies the displayed dense alternative. Degenerate ell=0 or r=0 extensions do not establish a nontrivial density endpoint.
The constructions are classical existence/counting results and give no algorithmic minimum-finding running-time guarantee.
integration_obligations_not_defects: FullStarEdgeBudgetDraft.lean is excluded from frozen production hashes, root imports, compilation claims, and this semantic verdict. Its final exact host-edge identity join remains uncompiled according to the review brief; the existing generic edge-loss identity must not be conflated with certification of that new wrapper.

QuotientSurplusPairs bounds actual unordered quotient surplus by full ordered-pair loss, and FullStarSurplusBudget bounds that ordered loss. This packet does not contain the excluded final host-edge-count wrapper or a completed density-increment assembly.
The explicit threshold 4*ell*(eps2*d)<=r remains a downstream parameter obligation. This review does not certify that illustrative source parameter choices meet it or preserve final asymptotics.
Regularization/packing-to-density-increment assembly and both main upper spanner bounds remain open. No new source defect, final source repair, or whole-paper completion is claimed.
